# Subzro

> Zero in on what matters. Subscription intelligence without a bank link.

Add recurring charges (PDF, CSV, Excel, or manual entry; no bank connection), see monthly spend, rate usage (Often / Sometimes / Rarely), and decide what to keep or cancel.

Site: https://subzro.vercel.app

## Public pages

- [Subzro](https://subzro.vercel.app/index.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/
- [Pricing](https://subzro.vercel.app/pricing.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/pricing
- [Privacy Policy](https://subzro.vercel.app/privacy.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/privacy
- [Terms of Service](https://subzro.vercel.app/terms.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/terms
- [Imprint](https://subzro.vercel.app/impressum.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/impressum
- [Refund and Withdrawal Policy](https://subzro.vercel.app/refund.md): HTML at https://subzro.vercel.app/refund

## Notes

- Use the .md URLs for a cheap, noindex markdown twin of each public HTML page.
- You can also send Accept: text/markdown to the HTML routes, or GET /api/md/<path>.
- /dashboard, /login, /signup, and /onboarding are private or account flows and have no markdown twins.
- Catalog: https://subzro.vercel.app/api/md/_catalog
- Full dump: https://subzro.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- Usage: https://subzro.vercel.app/ai.txt
